facts.text: Ivalina Hristova is listed on the EANM Executive Office directory as Chief Scientific Officer (首席科学官) of EARL.

EARL's organisational structure page states that one chief scientific officer oversees and coordinates EARL projects and teams, and reports to the CEO; EARL is an Austrian-registered GmbH and a 100% subsidiary of the EANM non-profit association.

EARL, launched by EANM in 2006 to promote multicentre nuclear medicine and research, runs PET/CT scanner accreditation and works to enhance comparability of molecular imaging data; as its Chief Scientific Officer, Hristova's role sits within this accreditation and research body.

EARL's current accreditation portfolio covers 18F PET/CT | PET/MR, brain PET/CT, 68Ga PET/CT | PET/MR, 89Zr PET/CT | PET/MR and 177Lu SPECT/CT accreditation, plus a Centres of Excellence network and SASAI audits.
EANM and EARL are headquartered at Schmalzhofgasse 26, 1060 Vienna, Austria; Hristova works within the Vienna-based EANM Executive Office.

background.text: Ivalina Hristova（伊瓦琳娜·赫里斯托娃）是欧洲核医学协会（EANM）执行办公室目录中列出的 EARL 首席科学官（Chief Scientific Officer）。EANM 于 2006 年设立 EANM Forschungs GmbH（EARL），作为推动多中心核医学与研究的机构；EARL 是 EANM 非营利协会的全资子公司，在奥地利注册，负责运行 PET/CT 扫描仪认证等质量与可比性项目。

根据 EARL 的组织结构说明，首席科学官负责监督和协调 EARL 的各项目与团队，并向首席执行官汇报；EANM 理事会中的科学联络官依章程负责 EARL 的活动。EARL 的认证范围目前涵盖 18F PET/CT|PET/MR、脑 PET/CT、68Ga PET/CT|PET/MR、89Zr PET/CT|PET/MR 和 177Lu SPECT/CT，并设有卓越中心网络与 SASAI 审计项目。与她会谈时，PET/CT 等设备认证流程、标准和多中心影像数据可比性是与其职务直接相关的话题。
EARL 团队还包括 PET/CT 科学顾问 Ronald Boellaard 和数据分析人员；EARL 依托来自欧洲领先机构的物理学家、医生和科学家以及科学顾问委员会提供科学支持。EANM/EARL 办公地址为维也纳 Schmalzhofgasse 26。

qa.answer: 官方 EANM 执行办公室目录使用的姓名是 Ivalina Hristova（并非请求中较短的 Iva 形式），职务为 EARL 首席科学官。

qa.question: EARL 首席科学官在组织中承担什么职责？
qa.answer: EARL 组织结构页说明：一名首席科学官监督并协调 EARL 的项目和团队，并向首席执行官汇报；EANM 理事会中的科学联络官依章程对 EARL 活动负责。

qa.question: EARL 的认证项目覆盖哪些设备和领域？
qa.answer: EARL 网站列出的认证范围包括 18F PET/CT|PET/MR、脑 PET/CT、68Ga PET/CT|PET/MR、89Zr PET/CT|PET/MR 以及 177Lu SPECT/CT，并提供认证流程时间表、规范和费用信息。

qa.question: EARL 与 EANM 是什么关系？
qa.answer: EARL（EANM Forschungs GmbH）是 2006 年由 EANM 领导层发起设立的机构，是在奥地利注册的有限责任公司、EANM 非营利协会的全资子公司，旨在推动多中心核医学与研究，并提升分子影像数据的可比性。

Structure
EARL is an in Austria registered GmbH and a 100% daughter of the EANM non-profit Association.
It has one CEO, who constantly reports to the EANM Board .
Within the EANM Board the Scientific Liaison Officer is per EANM statutes the responsible for the activities of EARL.
One chief scientific officer oversees and coordinates the EARL projects and teams, and reports to the CEO.
Physicists, physicians and scientists from leading European institutions , together with EANM support, ensure the expertise and authority of EARL.
EARL provides scientific support through the Scientific Advisory Board , where high-ranking experts in nuclear medicine provide leadership on scientific questions .
